data.title: 古手川唯 · 晨光窗边的慌乱掩襟
data.description: 刚借穿宽大白衬衫准备去拿换洗衣物，窗外忽然照进清亮晨光，恰好与推门进来的人打了个照面。古手川唯赤脚站在床边，一手急忙攥住敞开的衬衫衣襟遮挡粉色荷叶边胸衣，一手手足无措地示意你转身，羞愤得连耳根都红透了。
data.location: 洒满清晨阳光的整洁日式卧室窗边
data.action: 赤脚站于床边急忙拉拢敞开的白衬衫衣襟，羞愤脸红

data.camera: 平视中景，捕捉慌乱又可爱的风纪委员反差

data.promptProse: Caught off guard in the bright morning bedroom light, Yui Kotegawa hurriedly clutches the edges of her unbuttoned white dress shirt with one hand to shield her pastel-pink frilled bra while gesturing frantically with the other. Standing barefoot in sheer black pantyhose, her face and ears burn bright crimson.
data.animaCaption: Flustered in the sunlit bedroom, she hastily pulls her open white shirt together while blushing deeply.
data.nsfwProse: The unbuttoned white shirt parts to reveal pastel-pink lace frills above glossy sheer black pantyhose.
